score_change: Unchanged; 3/3 was already the maximum score.

health-digest.new_task: Build an internal inventory of device endpoints, query them concurrently under a hard deadline, and write a human-readable health digest for repeated runs on one controlled host.
health-digest.rationale: Both implementations passed all 10 health-digest cases, including concurrency and slow-trickle deadline cases. The related seven-pair health measurement favored Guion on observed runtime. This is workload-specific evidence, not a causal or language-wide claim.

timing.note: Process and oracle-check time included; fixture setup excluded; OS cache uncontrolled.

lockfile-auditor.new_task: Build a command-line software-bill-of-materials audit against team policy, reporting disallowed packages, version limits, and exceptions in deterministic JSON.
lockfile-auditor.rationale: Both implementations passed all 17 acceptance cases and 43 checks. In the evaluator’s seven-trial comparison, Guion’s median was about 5.5 times faster. This benchmark is a related lockfile task, not the exact new SBOM task.

timing.note: Named lockfile-auditor case; not the new SBOM task.

webhook-replay.new_task: Build a small durable notification relay that validates incoming payloads, records state, retries delivery, and reports failures to an operator.
webhook-replay.rationale: Both implementations passed the same 98 acceptance checks. Guion’s implementation makes transaction state explicit and records retry failures as dead letters with category and attempt details. The evaluator’s named webhook timing favored Guion.

timing.note: Named webhook-replay case; process and oracle-check time, not deployed relay latency.

current_runtime_change.interpretation: No clear latency improvement; estimated guest allocation-budget charges fell 0.36% in one profile.

limitations: Exploratory and unblinded: evaluators saw source and measurements.
